title: bug: daemon HTTP /health checks no Host header, so a DNS-rebinding browser page can read the daemon's pid and project path
description: Found by worker-fe18a9a9 on CQ-RF05 (task-b439d7fb), whose decision record docs/design/protected-profile-threat-model.md places browser pages inside the threat model. Problem class: a loopback HTTP endpoint answers any Host. packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:669 serves GET /health with pid, projectPath, version and stats, and never checks req.headers.host. The WebSocket Origin rule (task-801272c4) does not cover plain HTTP. Fix direction: answer /health only for a loopback-literal or localhost Host (plus the bind address), else 403; add vitest coverage. This row sits beside the HIGH row task-724e31fa (epic-be924fb8), and the governor may move it there. Keep the row's text at problem-class level, because .moe/tasks is pushed.
definitionOfDone: GET /health with a Host other than a loopback literal, localhost or the daemon's own bind address (with or without the port) gets 403 and no body fields; the existing clients (daemon CLI probe, launchers, IDE plugins) still pass.
vitest covers the allowed and refused Host values, including an absent Host.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md or docs/ARCHITECTURE.md notes the Host rule.

comments.author: governor-693b7073
comments.content: Governor note for the planner. Several in-flight rows now depend on reading /health from outside loopback: the cross-project-attach fixes, task-86093c3e (proxy), task-90664db1 (JetBrains), task-80ed1fe8 (VS Code) and parent task-e7f4026a (wrappers), all of which read /health projectPath. In WSL agent mode, the moe-agent.sh pre-flight (`probe_daemon_health`) and the proxy reach the Windows daemon through the WSL gateway IP, e.g. `http://172.26.208.1:9876/health`, so the request's Host is an IP literal, not localhost. A DNS-rebinding defense must keep those working. Rebinding needs a hostname, so the usual rule is: accept localhost and any IP-literal Host, and refuse other names. Please cover a gateway-IP Host in the tests, and keep /health's 200/503 + projectPath contract that 86093c3e/90664db1 classify on.
